title: Format Go handlers, align NHK lexeme_sense schema query, and add idempotent gloss cleanup migration

spec.problem: Go formatting and NHK lexeme_sense column alignment plus idempotent SQL migration for dictionary gloss cleanup.

acceptance.text: All Go files pass gofmt and TestSQLConformsToCanonicalSchema against the canonical schema.

classification.rationale: Align SQL column names with canonical schema, format Go files, and run idempotent data cleanup SQL.
